timing: After the complete ten-second PPG segment; simultaneous ECG supplies the target but is never an input. Known recording motion/contact conditions are allowed. No human quality annotation is a predictor.
eligibility: Source HR finite and positive; PPG reconstructable with nonzero variance. No good-quality-only selection; source Quality flag retained for diagnostics. Fixed search band30–240bpm is the candidate estimator domain, not an outcome exclusion.
selection: Whole-person mean MAE; smallest coefficient count within1% of best; >=5 adaptive hypotheses and two no-gain challenges before freeze.
exposure: PPG input waveform100001 and headers/design inspected; no ECG target values printed prefit. Public source study purpose known.
native_layout_amendment_before_fit: Support48 transposed single-red traces and3840 standard300×3 traces, choosing PPG_R in the latter; fixed red channel, no outcome-based channel selection.
